cpu_method.aggregation: linear interpolation and overlap-weighted trapezoid mean
cpu_method.plotting: not plotted; retained in cpu_exec_call_audit.csv only
cpu_method.sampler_scope: not encoded in resources.json; collector implementation samples AttemptContext.container_id
cpu_method.scope_limitation: artifact-level sampler/container identity cannot be independently verified retrospectively

exec_command_classification.attribution: first-head-only: the full exec-call latency is assigned to the first effective head; later commands receive no attribution
exec_command_classification.attribution_limitation: multi-command latency may be dominated by a later command; use operator_pattern and full CSV summaries when interpreting heads
exec_command_classification.head_extractor: first non-cd top-level command word from the bashlex AST; leading environment assignments are skipped
exec_command_classification.operator_pattern: no simple operator | sequential operators | pipeline/background operators | mixed operators | unclassified
exec_command_classification.operator_pattern_scope: bashlex top-level AST classification; leading cd segments are ignored, and operators nested in words, heredocs, command substitutions, process substitutions, or escaped arguments do not affect the outer call pattern; unsupported AST roots are unclassified
exec_command_classification.plot_kind: empirical CDF with a shared latency domain
exec_command_classification.plot_threshold_rationale: 100 calls gives 0.010 empirical probability resolution; all categories remain available in exec_command_summary.csv
exec_command_classification.pytest_category_rule: direct pytest executables and first-command Python '-m pytest' entry points are grouped as pytest

histogram.binning: numpy histogram_bin_edges with method='fd' on log1p milliseconds
histogram.series_normalization: each displayed series has total weight 1
